App_Tagline: Private workspace for your local network
Home_Subtitle: Your private workspace on the local network.
Home_Empty_Connected: Devices that are connected right now will appear here.
Home_Empty_Devices: Computers you have used before will appear here.
Home_Empty_Transfers: Files you send or receive will appear here.
Home_Empty_Games: Games you play will appear here.
Settings_LanguageHint: Language of the Rocal interface. Persian switches the whole layout to right-to-left.
Settings_TourHint: Replay the short introduction to Rocal.
ComingSoon_Text: This feature is planned for milestone {0} and is not available yet.
Onboarding_Note: Some features in this tour are still in development.
Onboarding_Step1_Body: Rocal finds other computers running Rocal on your local network automatically. No internet connection or account is needed.
Onboarding_Step2_Body: Select a computer and confirm a short code on both screens. Only paired devices can connect to you.
Onboarding_Step3_Body: Chat in real time or request a remote desktop session. The other person always has to approve it.
Onboarding_Step4_Body: Send files and folders directly between computers over your network, with progress and integrity checks.
Onboarding_Step5_Body: Create a private room, invite a connected computer and play multiplayer games.
